title: Transfection Protocol for Raw 264.7 \(Mouse Leukaemic Monocyte Macrophage Cell Line) in Targefect Handbook of Transfection Protocols
protocol: Grow cells to 70% confluency in 12-well plates.
Complex 6 μg DNA with 12 μl of targefect and 24 μl of Virofect in 0.6 ml of serum-free high glucose DMEM.
Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 20 minutes to form transfection complexes, shaking well after each addition.
Dilute 125 ul of transfection complexes in an equal amount of complete medium and add to the cells.
Incubate with cells for 2 hours at 37 °C.
Add 600-800 μl of complete medium to the cells.
Aspirate all media from a 6-well dish, leaving 500 μl of supernatant on the cells.
Mix 250 μl of transfection complex with 500 μl of cell supernatants and incubate overnight for improved results.
For 24-well dishes, add 70 ul of transfection complex per well.
